RHFiles Windows native playback: libVLC 3.0.24 (win-x64)
Copyright (C) 1996-2026 the VideoLAN team and contributors.

This directory contains the unmodified native runtime from VideoLAN's
VideoLAN.LibVLC.Windows 3.0.24 NuGet package (LGPL-2.1-or-later), not the
VideoLAN.LibVLC.Windows.GPL package or the complete VLC application.
The full license is in COPYING.LIB; upstream package metadata is preserved.
RHFiles original code remains under its own Apache-2.0 license.

Binary provenance:
https://www.nuget.org/packages/VideoLAN.LibVLC.Windows/3.0.24
https://code.videolan.org/videolan/libvlc-nuget

Corresponding VLC source, contributors, build instructions and dependency
recipes (contrib/) for this version:
https://download.videolan.org/pub/videolan/vlc/3.0.24/vlc-3.0.24.tar.xz
https://github.com/videolan/vlc/tree/3.0.24
FFmpeg source used by this VLC version:
https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz
Other included components retain their respective licenses and copyrights;
see the upstream source's THANKS and contrib/src recipes for their sources.

RHFiles dynamically loads libvlc.dll/libvlccore.dll and the plugins. You can
replace them with a compatible modified 64-bit VLC 3.x runtime; there is no
runtime checksum restriction. Build-time checks protect release assembly,
not the user's ability to modify or relink the library. See RHFiles source:
https://github.com/RailgunHamster/RHFiles

plugins/plugins.dat is generated for exactly the distributed non-GPL plugin
set at build time using the matching official VLC cache generator. That GPL
build tool is not distributed in this application runtime directory.

RHFiles reads this matching-version index without rescanning plugin files:
Velopack uses deterministic ZIP timestamps which differ from source DLL
timestamps. It does not rewrite installed files. If your modified runtime
changes plugin metadata, regenerate plugins.dat or remove RHFiles-libVLC.json
to return to VLC's normal cache-and-scan behavior.
